business_summary.text: Raymond Limited operates branded textiles and apparel (B2C), high-value cotton garmenting and shirting (B2B), and engineering businesses including precision technology, auto components, and aerospace & defence.

call_points.text: Raymond is executing a ₹930 Cr capex program over 5 years, with ₹500 Cr for aerospace and ₹430 Cr for precision auto at Gudipalli.
Aerospace & Defence holds an order book of ₹2,350+ Cr executable over the next 5 years.
Setting up a new Aerospace facility in Gudipalli, Andhra Pradesh with ₹500 Cr capex over 5 years.
Precision Technology & Auto facility planned at Gudipalli with ₹430 Cr capex over 5 years.
Ground breaking completed for Andhra facilities near Bengaluru Airport; commercial production targeted for late 2027.
Secured maiden build-to-spec defence order for specialised onboard storage systems in Q4.
Onboarded an American Tier 1 Engine customer and progressed discussions with a European Tier 1 manufacturer.
Aerospace sustained Q4 EBITDA margin at 25.5% while expensing R&D fully.
Management reiterated that Raymond Limited continues to remain net cash surplus at group level.

operating_notes.text: FY26 exceptional items of ₹201.42 Cr include a ₹167.40 Cr goodwill reversal on the JK Files/Maini scheme and ₹26.50 Cr stamp duty on the demerger.
Aerospace & Defence FY26 EBITDA margin was 22.3% versus 22.4% in FY25, with R&D for the new product pipeline fully expensed.
Precision Technology & Auto Components FY26 EBITDA of ₹223 Cr included a non-recurring gain of about ₹13 Cr from a Q2 land sale.
Aerospace order book stands at ₹2,350+ Cr over next 5 years.
Planning ₹500 Cr aerospace and ₹430 Cr auto capex over 5 years at Gudipalli, Andhra Pradesh.
Aerospace & Defense business reported FY26 revenue of ₹392 Cr with EBITDA of ₹88 Cr (22.3% margin).
Aerospace & Defence revenue reached an all-time high of ₹139 Cr in Q2FY27, up 72% YoY.

timeline.summary: Raymond outlined ₹930 Cr capex over 5 years for Gudipalli engineering plants and reported a ₹2,350+ Cr aerospace order book.
On May 5, 2026, Raymond Limited submitted the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call.
Gautam Hari Singhania, on behalf of Raymond Limited’s promoters, declared no new encumbrances on shareholding under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 1, 2026.
Raymond hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, detailing a ₹930 Cr multi-year capex plan for Andhra Pradesh engineering facilities and robust aerospace growth.
Raymond's board approved issuing up to 66,57,373 convertible warrants at ₹497 each to promoter group entity JK Investors (Bombay), raising up to ₹330.88 Cr.

Raymond Limited’s promoters and promoter group members, including **Gautam Hari Singhania**, **Niharika Gautam Singhania**, **Nawaz Singhania**, and others, declared no new encumbrances on their shareholding under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY 2025-26.
Raymond clarified post-preferential shareholding percentages for Minerva Ventures Fund's warrant allotment following exchange queries.
Board of Directors approved change of name to Raymond Aerospace, Defence & Engineering Limited effective 24 October 2026.
Raymond Limited reported Q2FY27 continuing revenue of ₹655.16 Cr and net profit of ₹32.06 Cr.
Raymond Limited reported Q2FY27 total income of ₹683 Cr and EBITDA of ₹103 Cr, driven by growth in its engineering businesses.
